name: KnownOrigin
rootCause: KnownOrigin officially tweeted that its discord had been attacked, and reminded users not to click on any links. Other servers hacked in recent days include those of Curiosity, Meta Hunters, Parallel, Goat Society, RFTP and Gooniez.
